supportArticles.title: What does PREVIEW mean?
supportArticles.body: PREVIEW identifies an evaluation build or concept. It does not mean a public release.

supportArticles.title: Where is guest progress saved?
supportArticles.body: Feast Pass progress can persist locally in this browser. Sign-in and cross-device sync are not available.

supportArticles.title: Where can I get the mobile app?
supportArticles.body: The App page explains current availability. Verified App Store and Google Play destinations are not configured on this preview.

supportArticles.title: How do I contact support?
supportArticles.body: The Contact page is a non-submitting preview until a verified public mailbox or endpoint is configured.

supportArticles.title: Where are Privacy Policy and Terms?
supportArticles.body: The Legal page records publication status. Approved Privacy Policy and Terms text is not published yet.

roadmapItems.title: Browser game previews
roadmapItems.description: Four browser-game listings remain preview or concept surfaces; none is marked PUBLIC.

roadmapItems.title: Guest Feast Pass
roadmapItems.description: Browser-local Feast Pass, quests, rewards and guest profile are available on the review candidate without account sync.

roadmapItems.title: Community
roadmapItems.description: A curated community area is prepared, but posting and social services are not live.

roadmapItems.title: Store
roadmapItems.description: A store preview exists without products, prices, cart or checkout.

roadmapItems.title: Account sync
roadmapItems.description: Guest progress is local to this browser; sign-in and cross-device sync remain planned.
